clue.text: In a city there is something growing towards the rising sun

indicators.note: the growing thing is placed in the cathedral city's name, so the city wraps it

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire
an aster is a garden flower

explanation.surface: A city boasts a plant that grows towards the dawn.
explanation.definitionFit: The sun rises in the east, so a direction towards it is eastward.

clue.text: Expire like Henry in the river

indicators.note: the name for Henry sits within the river's name, which wraps around it

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon
Hal is the familiar name of Prince Henry in Shakespeare

explanation.surface: Someone dies like a king drowned in a river.
explanation.definitionFit: To expire is literally to breathe out, a synonym in that sense.

clue.text: Leap time

explanation.definitionFit: Both a bound into the air and the season after winter carry this word.

clue.text: Consumption of what are mostly former writers

annotationWithheld.why: 'Consumption of what are mostly former writers (7)': EX (former) + PENS (writers) gives EXPENS; no clue word supplies the final E and 'mostly' trims nothing, so the clue as held looks garbled
annotationWithheld.clue: Consumption of what are mostly former writers

clue.text: Cuts off trainee at work on Sunday

parts.note: L is a learner, as on an L-plate
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: An apprentice is sent in on the weekend to trim branches.
explanation.definitionFit: To lop a branch is to cut it off a tree.

clue.text: Descended from a noble person who has lost a thousand

indicators.note: losing marks the letter for a thousand being taken out of the word for a noble

parts.note: a magnate is a great or noble person
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: An aristocrat's descendant who has squandered a fortune.
explanation.definitionFit: An agnate relative is one related through male descent from a common ancestor.

clue.text: Plant is one that shoots at first

parts.note: a gunner fires guns

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word at is taken

explanation.surface: A plant that fires off shoots before others do.
explanation.definitionFit: Gunnera is a genus of giant-leaved waterside plants.

clue.text: Place of departure which gives publicity to the journey

parts.note: to air something is to make it public
a trip is a journey

explanation.surface: A launch spot where the journey gets promoted.
explanation.definitionFit: Aircraft depart from a landing strip, the field where planes take off.

clue.text: All extremely united behind an egghead

indicators.note: the words for extremely and united come after the egg's head letter

parts.note: the head, or first letter, of egg is E
very means extremely
one means united, as in at one

explanation.surface: Everybody rallies wholeheartedly behind a clever intellectual.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Egghead' looks like an intellectual but gives only the head of egg, E.
explanation.definitionFit: All people taken together are everybody.

clue.text: Dance from a naval star in a place in Plymouth

indicators.note: the naval star goes into the Plymouth place, which surrounds it

parts.note: Plymouth Hoe is the clifftop green in the English port of Plymouth
RN is Royal Navy
a pip is a star on an officer's shoulder

explanation.surface: A sailor puts on a jig on Plymouth's waterfront.
explanation.definitionFit: The hornpipe is the lively solo dance associated with sailors.

clue.text: Course of the broken tree-line

indicators.note: the answer is formed of letters lying within the next words, running across them

explanation.surface: The route of a tree-line that has gaps in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Broken' looks like an anagram signal, but the dish sits whole across 'brokEN TREE-line'.
explanation.definitionFit: An entree is a dish or course of a meal.

clue.text: Insect on the cheese momentarily

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sits on the other, so the cheese comes first

parts.note: brie is a soft French cheese
a fly is an insect

explanation.surface: A fly lands briefly on the cheese board.
explanation.definitionFit: Briefly means for a short moment.

clue.text: Batting in the heather, being not out

indicators.note: the not-out state is put inside the heather word, which wraps it

parts.note: ling is a common heather
in cricket a batsman not out is in

explanation.surface: A batsman playing on a heath, still not dismissed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Batting' looks like cricket but is the definition: batting is cotton wadding used as padding.
explanation.definitionFit: Batting is soft padding, the material for an inner layer of a quilt or garment.

clue.text: Passionately but with depression in the river

indicators.note: the depression sits inside the river's name, which wraps it

parts.note: the Arly is a river in the French Alps
a dent is a hollow or depression

explanation.surface: Someone sinks into a river with great fervour despite feeling low.
explanation.definitionFit: Ardently means with burning zeal, eagerly.

clue.text: Lady almost expected to be on the game

indicators.note: the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: due means expected
chess is the board game

explanation.surface: A woman is nearly ready to join the game.
explanation.definitionFit: A duchess is a noblewoman, a titled lady.

clue.text: Recovery is possibly pure reaction

indicators.note: the letters might possibly be arranged in another order

explanation.surface: A clean response may be the start of getting better.
explanation.definitionFit: Recuperation is the process of getting well again.

clue.text: Incorrectly draw swimmer rather small

indicators.note: the letters of draw are set down in the wrong order

parts.note: a fish is a swimmer

explanation.surface: Someone sketches a fish badly, making it too tiny.
explanation.definitionFit: Dwarfish means small in stature, like a dwarf.

clue.text: Fishes for those who take pictures

definitions.meaning: plural of a family of food fish

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a family of sea fish and people who take quick photos.

clue.text: Artist in cold weather given rope

parts.note: winter is the cold season
a halter is a rope for leading a horse

explanation.surface: A painter out in the frost with a length of rope.
explanation.definitionFit: Franz Xaver Winterhalter was a German portrait painter to European royalty.

clue.text: Instruct with points about money

indicators.note: the points go around the money, enclosing it

parts.note: E and E are two compass points, east
a ducat is an old gold coin

explanation.surface: Teaching someone to make points about finance.
explanation.definitionFit: To educate is to teach or instruct.

clue.text: Ask about a letter on paper

parts.note: en is the name of the letter N
a quire is a set of 24 or 25 sheets of paper

explanation.surface: Writing a letter on a sheet to request information.
explanation.definitionFit: To enquire into something is to ask questions about it.

clue.text: Allow nothing to be put up — it goes at top of the door

definitions.text: it goes at top of the door

indicators.note: in a down entry, putting something up reads it from the bottom upward

parts.note: let means allow
nil is nothing

explanation.surface: Nothing is permitted to be hung above the doorway.
explanation.definitionFit: A lintel is the horizontal beam over a door or window.

clue.text: Gentlemen and female about to go wrong

indicators.note: the female bird goes about, or round, the error word

parts.note: a hen is a female bird
to err is to go wrong

explanation.surface: Men and women are both about to make mistakes.
explanation.definitionFit: Herren is German for gentlemen or sirs.

clue.text: We are in sleep a work of art

indicators.note: the speakers are placed inside the word for sleep

parts.note: repose is rest or sleep
us is the object form of we

explanation.surface: We sleep in a gallery among the masterpieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Repousse is ornamental metalwork hammered into relief from the reverse side.

clue.text: Point on paper for country gentleman

parts.note: S is south, a compass point
a quire is a set of sheets of paper

explanation.surface: A landowner notes something on a sheet of paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A squire is the chief landowner of an English village.

clue.text: Cure for those who are sick on the quiet

indicators.note: in a down entry the sick sit on top of the quiet letter, so it comes first

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical mark for quiet
the ill are those who are sick

explanation.surface: Medicine given discreetly to patients.
explanation.definitionFit: A pill is a tablet of medicine, a remedy.

clue.text: Arctic feature seen in the middle of attractive headgear

indicators.note: the answer sits within the phrase, lacking its first letter

parts.note: nice means attractive or pleasant
a cap is a piece of headgear

explanation.surface: Something wintry spotted in a fetching hat.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is hidden not in the clue words but in their synonym NICE CAP, losing only the N.
explanation.definitionFit: A polar ice cap is a permanent sheet of ice over polar land.

clue.text: I am in church as a member of the government

indicators.note: the speaker is placed inside the church word

parts.note: a minster is a large church

explanation.surface: Someone in a cathedral says they are part of the cabinet.
explanation.definitionFit: A minister is a senior politician who heads a department.

clue.text: Possesses a number to provide with speed

parts.note: has means possesses
ten is a number

explanation.surface: Someone owns a figure meant to speed things up.
explanation.definitionFit: To hasten something is to make it go faster, to hurry it on.

clue.text: Henry's officer means sickness to a girl

parts.note: flu is influenza, a sickness
Ellen is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A royal officer means bad news for a girl.
explanation.definitionFit: Fluellen is the Welsh captain in Shakespeare's Henry V.
